reader_summary.headline: Today I’m joined by two Hollywood greats, Ron Howard and Brian Grazer.
reader_summary.overview: Today I’m joined by two Hollywood greats, Ron Howard and Brian Grazer. They have produced, directed, written, and acted in a number of the most popular films and tv shows ever made, including Apollo 13, A Beautiful Mind. Their partnership is one of the longest running in Hollywood, and the business they founded in 1985, Imagine Entertainment, has won 49 EMMY awards.

key_points.text: They have produced, directed, written, and acted in a number of the most popular films and tv shows ever made, including Apollo 13.
Their partnership is one of the longest running in Hollywood, and the business they founded in 1985, Imagine Entertainment, has won 49 EMMY awards.
There are few better storytellers in the world and it was a thrill to talk about curiosity, trust, and business building with them both.
